blocks.text: Donny Pangilinan said he did not take offense over Showtime Baby Dolls member Juby’s sexual dream about him, although he admitted feeling “awkward” about it. Juby spoke about her dream that supposedly involved a sexual encounter with Pangilinan, her celebrity crush, during her and her fellow members’ guesting on “Gandang Gabi, Vice” last Oct. 18. Her remarks drew criticisms on social media, with netizens calling them inappropriate. Pangilinan spoke on the matter during a “TV Patrol” interview on Tuesday, Oct. 27. “I personally don’t think naman that she meant anything bad with it, to hurt someone.
